newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: South Korea welcomes Hong Kong handover to China.
newsitem.headline: South Korea welcomes Hong Kong handover to China.

text.p: South Korea on Tuesday welcomed the return of Hong Kong to Chinese control and said it would seek closer ties with China's new special region.
"The Government of the Republic of Korea welcomes the transfer of Hong Kong's sovereignty to China," a foreign ministry statement said.
"We also express the hope that the substantive cooperative relationship between Korea and Hong Kong will continue to be expanded and deepened in the years ahead."
Hong Kong is South Korea's fourth largest export market.
Seoul's ties with Beijing have grown rapidly since the two nations set up diplomatic relations in 1992.
